name: Sable Loupe
tagline: The house of record for every object worth doubting.
positioning: Sable Loupe gives independent resellers a museum-grade authentication and provenance system, so a single owner can vouch for a $40k watch with total confidence.

hero.h1: Authenticate like a house, not a hobbyist.
hero.sub: Sable Loupe turns your back-room gut checks into signed, defensible provenance — a permanent record that outlives the sale and protects the price you command.

features.title: Provenance dossiers
features.description: Assemble serials, receipts, service history, and macro shots into one signed dossier that travels with the piece — and settles disputes before they start.

features.title: Reference-grade comparison
features.description: Match hallmarks, stitching, movement engravings, and date codes against a curated library of verified references for watches, leather, and jewelry.

features.title: Counterfeit flagging
features.description: Sable Loupe surfaces the tells — reused serials, off-spec fonts, known super-fake batches — the moment an intake photo hits your queue.

features.title: Digital certificates
features.description: Issue a tamper-evident certificate with a scannable seal, so your buyer sees a verifiable record instead of your word on a sticky note.

features.title: Consignment intake
features.description: Photograph, grade, and price a consignment on your phone in minutes, with every step timestamped to the operator who touched it.

features.title: Resale valuation
features.description: Anchor every listing to live secondary-market comps so you stop leaving margin on the table and stop scaring off buyers.

testimonials.quote: A client tried to return a 'fake' Royal Oak we'd sold. The Sable Loupe dossier — movement shots, serial trace, the whole chain — ended the argument in ninety seconds. That's the entire business right there.
testimonials.name: Mireille Aubert

testimonials.quote: I used to authenticate handbags by memory and prayer. Now every intake gets a signed certificate my resale buyers actually trust. My average sale price is up because doubt is gone.
testimonials.name: Devon Marsh

testimonials.quote: We onboarded two new appraisers in a week because the reference library does the teaching. What used to live in one person's head is now the whole shop's standard.
testimonials.name: Priya Nair

pricing.blurb: For the solo operator building a name on trust.
For growing shops with more hands than hours.
For multi-location dealers and authentication desks.

homepage.footerBlurb: Sable Loupe is the house of record for luxury resale — where a single owner can authenticate with the authority of an institution.
